description: React component for managing workspace users, including listing, searching, adding, editing, and removing users, with API interactions and UI dialogs.

methods.name: onUsersSelectAllClick
methods.description: Handles select/deselect all users in the workspace user list.

methods.name: isUserSelected
methods.description: Checks if a user is currently selected.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new user to the workspace.

methods.name: onEditClick
methods.description: Handles click on edit button for a user, opening appropriate dialog.

methods.name: editInvite
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an invited user's details.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing user's role.

methods.name: unlinkUser
methods.description: Removes selected users from the workspace after confirmation.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Refreshes user list after dialog actions.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search term for filtering users.

methods.name: filterUsers
methods.description: Filters user list based on search term.
